meta.title: JEV Tiered Harness
meta.description: Tiered LLM tools for DeepSeek Harness: harness_call routes decision/quality tasks to Kimi K3.1Pro and routine execution to DeepSeek4.1Flash101 via OpenAI-compatible gateways. Includes harness_classify (tier decision), harness_review (second-model quality gate) and harness_probe (connectivity + real model id discovery). Keys come from JEV_API_KEY / KIMI_API_KEY / DSF_API_KEY; set each gateway base URL and exact model id in plugin settings.
